subject: Market day changes
text: Heads up, the pop-up market shifts to Saturday the twelfth, not Sunday. It kicks off at ten outside the north pavilion, not by the gate. Booths stay open till five, and we get the smaller tent near the coffee cart. I grabbed two staff passes, but one expires if we do not register online tonight. There is a snag, though: my dentist appointment clashes with the volunteer briefing at eight thirty. Could you swing by and catch the safety chat? I will make up the hours by stacking crates after close. Also, bring the blue tote, since the invoice folder is buried in my car. Lunch should land around noon, so grab a snack beforehand if hunger strikes. Keep your phone close; the organizer texts weather updates. I will confirm the load-in window once the vendor list is locked.
